hooks.name: Warn when local wecare.digital is stale
hooks.description: Fetches origin/wecare.digital and warns when the local wecare.digital ref is behind it. This is intentionally warning-only: it never moves refs or touches the working tree, because a session may start with unrelated uncommitted work.

action.command:
D=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; git -C "$D" fetch --quiet origin wecare.digital >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git -C "$D" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/wecare.digital || exit 0; git -C "$D" show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/wecare.digital || exit 0; behind=$(git -C "$D" rev-list --count wecare.digital..origin/wecare.digital 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; ahead=$(git -C "$D" rev-list --count origin/wecare.digital..wecare.digital 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then printf '
STALE WECARE.DIGITAL WARNING: local wecare.digital is %s commit(s) behind origin/wecare.digital and %s ahead. Sync wecare.digital before any merge or push. Suggested safe command: git fetch origin && git switch wecare.digital && git merge --ff-only origin/wecare.digital

' "$behind" "$ahead" >&2; fi
